text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
        Summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover for eligible poor and vulnerable families at empanelled public and private hospitals across India. Coverage: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for listed packages (state-wise implementation may vary).
        Coverage: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for listed packages (state-wise implementation may vary)
        Eligibility: Target: Poor and vulnerable households as per SECC and state lists. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: Primarily SECC 2011 and other notified categories; no single universal income ceiling. BPL/SECC Required: SECC 2011 or other notified category.
        Covered Conditions: Secondary and tertiary hospitalization, Major surgeries, Oncology, Cardiovascular procedures
        Exclusions: Routine OPD outside packages, Cosmetic procedures, Non-approved treatment
        State: Central / All India (implemented in most States/UTs)
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

metadata.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (PM-JAY for 70+)
        Summary: Dedicated Ayushman card for all Indian citizens aged 70 years and above, enabling cashless secondary and tertiary hospital treatment under AB-PMJAY. Coverage: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible senior citizen family unit per year under PM-JAY packages.
        Coverage: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible senior citizen family unit per year under PM-JAY packages
        Eligibility: Target: All Indian citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income. Age: Senior Citizens (70 years and above). Income Limit: No income ceiling for 70+ category. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Secondary and tertiary hospitalization, Major surgeries, Oncology, Cardiac procedures
        Exclusions: Routine OPD outside packages, Cosmetic procedures, Non-approved treatment
        State: Central / All India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
        Summary: Comprehensive medical care for eligible Central Government employees, pensioners and dependents, including OPD, medicines, diagnostics and hospitalization under CGHS rules. Coverage: No fixed annual sum insured; governed by CGHS entitlement and approved rates.
        Coverage: No fixed annual sum insured; governed by CGHS entitlement and approved rates
        Eligibility: Target: Central Government employees, pensioners and eligible dependents. Age: Eligible employees, pensioners and dependents. Income Limit: N/A. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: OPD consultation, Diagnostics, Medicines, Hospitalization
        Exclusions: Non-beneficiaries, Unapproved services, Non-medically necessary procedures
        State: Central / Selected cities and Government establishments in India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESIC)
        Summary: Social security and health insurance for organized-sector employees and their families, covering hospitalization, maternity, disability and dependents' benefits. Coverage: No fixed annual sum insured; benefits as per ESIC rules and wage limits.
        Coverage: No fixed annual sum insured; benefits as per ESIC rules and wage limits
        Eligibility: Target: Employees in ESIC-covered establishments and their families. Age: Working-age employees and dependents. Income Limit: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 per month (₹25,000 for persons with disabilities). BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Hospitalization, Maternity care, Disability benefits, Dependents' benefits in case of employment-related death
        Exclusions: Employees above wage ceiling, Establishments not covered under ESIC, Non-medically necessary procedures
        State: Central / Implemented in 668+ districts across India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Employees' State Insurance Corporation, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

Scheme: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
        Summary: Health insurance for persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation or Multiple Disabilities, covering hospitalization, OPD, therapy and transport costs. Coverage: Up to ₹1 lakh per year on reimbursement basis.
        Coverage: Up to ₹1 lakh per year on reimbursement basis
        Eligibility: Target: Persons with specified disabilities holding valid disability certificate and UDID. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: No income ceiling. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Hospitalization, OPD, Physiotherapy, Speech therapy, Dental care, Transport costs
        Exclusions: Persons without eligible disability certificate, Treatments outside scheme rules, Non-reimbursable expenses
        State: Central / All India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: National Trust for the Care of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

Scheme: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
        Summary: One-time financial assistance for BPL patients with specified life-threatening diseases receiving treatment in eligible Government hospitals. Coverage: Case-based one-time grant; no universal fixed amount.
        Coverage: Case-based one-time grant; no universal fixed amount
        Eligibility: Target: BPL patients with specified life-threatening diseases. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: Applicable BPL threshold. BPL/SECC Required: BPL required.
        Covered Conditions: Specified life-threatening diseases, Cancer and other listed serious illnesses, Major treatment in Government hospitals
        Exclusions: Non-BPL applicants, Private treatment outside rules, Already incurred expenditure, Treatment available free elsewhere
        State: Central / All India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
        Summary: Direct maternity benefit for eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers from specified disadvantaged groups. Coverage: ₹5000 for first living child; ₹6000 for second living child if the second child is a girl, subject to conditions.
        Coverage: ₹5000 for first living child; ₹6000 for second living child if the second child is a girl, subject to conditions
        Eligibility: Target: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers. Age: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers. Income Limit: No single universal ceiling; eligible disadvantaged categories apply. BPL/SECC Required: Not universally required.
        Covered Conditions: Pregnancy registration, Antenatal care, Childbirth, Child immunization
        Exclusions: Failure to meet milestone conditions, Duplicate benefits, Claims outside permitted child-order rules
        State: Central / All India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
        Summary: Free, assured antenatal care on the 9th of every month for all pregnant women at designated government health facilities. Coverage: Free antenatal services; no fixed monetary limit.
        Coverage: Free antenatal services; no fixed monetary limit
        Eligibility: Target: All pregnant women, especially in second and third trimester. Age: Pregnant Women. Income Limit: N/A. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Antenatal check-ups, Blood tests, Ultrasound, Blood pressure monitoring, Nutritional counseling
        Exclusions: Non-antenatal services, Private facility care outside programme rules
        State: Central / All India
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
        Summary: Free and no-expense delivery, caesarean section, medicines, diagnostics, blood, diet and transport in public health institutions for eligible pregnant women and sick newborns. Coverage: No fixed monetary limit; free-of-cost entitlement under programme rules.
        Coverage: No fixed monetary limit; free-of-cost entitlement under programme rules
        Eligibility: Target: Pregnant women delivering in public institutions and eligible sick newborns. Age: Pregnant Women and Newborns. Income Limit: N/A for the universal public-facility entitlement, subject to programme rules. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Normal delivery, Caesarean delivery, Sick newborn care, Diagnostics, Blood and medicines, Transport
        Exclusions: Non-public-facility care outside programme rules, Non-eligible services, Services after the applicable entitlement period
        State: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
        Summary: Safe-motherhood cash assistance programme encouraging institutional delivery among eligible pregnant women under Government rules. Coverage: Amount varies by State, rural or urban location and beneficiary category; no single India-wide amount.
        Coverage: Amount varies by State, rural or urban location and beneficiary category; no single India-wide amount
        Eligibility: Target: Eligible pregnant women, especially poor and vulnerable women. Age: Pregnant Women. Income Limit: Eligibility depends on current JSY State and category rules. BPL/SECC Required: BPL or other notified category may be required.
        Covered Conditions: Institutional delivery, Antenatal and postnatal care linkage, Maternal referral support
        Exclusions: Applicants outside notified categories, Incomplete institutional-delivery conditions, Duplicate claims
        State: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India; implemented by State NHM

Scheme: National Health Mission (NHM)
        Summary: Umbrella public-health mission supporting rural and urban health services, maternal and child health, communicable and non-communicable disease programmes, health-system strengthening and free or subsidized public services. Coverage: Programme-specific; no single insurance amount.
        Coverage: Programme-specific; no single insurance amount
        Eligibility: Target: Residents using public health services and programme-specific target groups. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: Varies by programme; many public-health services are not income-restricted. BPL/SECC Required: Varies by programme.
        Covered Conditions: Maternal and child health, Immunization, Communicable diseases, Non-communicable diseases, Public primary healthcare
        Exclusions: Services outside the relevant programme, Non-authorized private treatment, Programme-specific eligibility exclusions
        State: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: Central Government
        Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

Scheme: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
        Summary: Cashless hospitalization insurance for eligible Tamil Nadu resident families at empanelled hospitals, with coverage enhanced to ₹25 lakh per family per year as announced in August 2026. Coverage: Up to ₹25 lakh per eligible family per year (announced August 2026; implementation ongoing).
        Coverage: Up to ₹25 lakh per eligible family per year (announced August 2026; implementation ongoing)
        Eligibility: Target: Eligible low-income Tamil Nadu resident families. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: Less than ₹120000 per family per year under existing eligibility documentation. BPL/SECC Required: No; income and family-card eligibility apply.
        Covered Conditions: Secondary and tertiary hospitalization, Oncology, Cardiac procedures, Major surgeries
        Exclusions: Routine OPD outside packages, Cosmetic procedures, Non-approved treatment
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

metadata.scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)

text:
Scheme: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (MRMBS)
        Summary: Maternity assistance scheme providing ₹18000 per eligible beneficiary through cash instalments and two nutrition kits, subject to pregnancy registration, antenatal care, childbirth and immunization conditions. Coverage: ₹18000 per eligible beneficiary, including cash and nutrition-kit benefits, subject to current guidelines.
        Coverage: ₹18000 per eligible beneficiary, including cash and nutrition-kit benefits, subject to current guidelines
        Eligibility: Target: Eligible poor pregnant women and mothers. Age: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers. Income Limit: Poor or eligible pregnant women under current Tamil Nadu guidelines. BPL/SECC Required: Eligibility-category and income conditions apply; not an insurance scheme.
        Covered Conditions: Pregnancy registration, Antenatal care, Childbirth, Child immunization, Nutrition support
        Exclusions: Failure to meet milestone conditions, Duplicate benefits, Ineligible applicants
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

metadata.scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (MRMBS)

text:
Scheme: Amma Baby Care Kit
        Summary: Distribution of a newborn care kit to eligible babies delivered in Government health institutions under Tamil Nadu maternal and child-health programmes. Coverage: In-kind benefit; value and contents depend on current Tamil Nadu Government specifications.
        Coverage: In-kind benefit; value and contents depend on current Tamil Nadu Government specifications
        Eligibility: Target: Babies born in eligible Tamil Nadu Government health institutions. Age: Newborns. Income Limit: Generally linked to delivery in eligible Government facilities and current State rules. BPL/SECC Required: Not universally required; facility and State conditions apply.
        Covered Conditions: Newborn hygiene, Basic newborn care, Maternal and child-health support
        Exclusions: Births outside eligible facilities or rules, Duplicate distribution, Items outside the approved kit
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

Scheme: Amma Arokiya Scheme
        Summary: Preventive health-screening initiative providing basic health checks and investigations through public health facilities, especially for adults aged 30 years and above. Coverage: Free or Government-funded screening services; no fixed insurance sum.
        Coverage: Free or Government-funded screening services; no fixed insurance sum
        Eligibility: Target: Tamil Nadu residents eligible for public preventive screening. Age: Adults aged 30 years and above. Income Limit: N/A. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Non-communicable disease screening, Blood pressure screening, Diabetes screening, Basic investigations
        Exclusions: Specialist treatment outside the screening service, Non-programme investigations, Private services outside authorization
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

Scheme: Nammai Kaakkum 48
        Summary: Tamil Nadu emergency-care programme providing cashless treatment during the first 48 hours after eligible road-traffic accidents and other notified emergencies, subject to current Government rules and hospital authorization. Coverage: Up to ₹200000 for eligible treatment under the cited revised Tamil Nadu Government provision.
        Coverage: Up to ₹200000 for eligible treatment under the cited revised Tamil Nadu Government provision
        Eligibility: Target: Eligible emergency and accident patients in Tamil Nadu. Age: All Ages. Income Limit: N/A. BPL/SECC Required: No; emergency and scheme conditions apply.
        Covered Conditions: Emergency stabilization, Accident injuries, Critical care, Surgery and trauma care
        Exclusions: Non-eligible cases, Treatment outside notified emergency period, Non-approved services
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

Scheme: Nalam 360 - Annual Free Health Check-up for All
        Summary: Annual free health check-up for all Tamil Nadu residents aged 30 years and above, offering 14 basic tests at government health facilities, with plans for home-based diagnostic services in metropolitan areas. Coverage: Free screening services; no fixed insurance amount.
        Coverage: Free screening services; no fixed insurance amount
        Eligibility: Target: Tamil Nadu residents aged 30+ using public health facilities. Age: Adults aged 30 years and above. Income Limit: N/A. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Blood pressure screening, ECG, Haemoglobin and complete haemogram, Random blood sugar, Kidney function tests, Lipid profile, Liver function tests, Urine albumin, VIA cervical screening
        Exclusions: Specialist treatment outside the screening service, Non-programme investigations, Private services outside authorization
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

metadata.scheme_name: Nalam 360 - Annual Free Health Check-up for All

text:
Scheme: Chief Minister's Elderly Health Insurance Scheme
        Summary: Free health insurance for Tamil Nadu residents aged 70 years and above, covering super-speciality treatment including cancer care, advanced cardiac surgeries, organ transplants and high-end diagnostics at empanelled government and private hospitals, with no income ceiling. Coverage: No fixed monetary ceiling stated in announcement; covers specified super-speciality packages.
        Coverage: No fixed monetary ceiling stated in announcement; covers specified super-speciality packages
        Eligibility: Target: Tamil Nadu residents aged 70 years and above. Age: Senior Citizens (70 years and above). Income Limit: No income ceiling. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Cancer care packages, Advanced cardiac surgeries, Organ transplants, High-end diagnostic services, Super-speciality treatment at empanelled hospitals
        Exclusions: Non-empanelled treatment outside scheme rules, Services not covered under approved packages, Beneficiaries below age 70
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

metadata.scheme_name: Chief Minister's Elderly Health Insurance Scheme

text:
Scheme: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme (Employees)
        Summary: Health insurance for Tamil Nadu government employees and eligible family members, providing cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals with basic sum insured of ₹7.50 lakh and up to ₹12 lakh for specified illnesses, effective July 2026 for a five-year block. Coverage: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; Corpus Fund up to 1500000 for rare/specified illnesses (employees only).
        Coverage: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; Corpus Fund up to 1500000 for rare/specified illnesses (employees only)
        Eligibility: Target: Government employees, eligible family members, and specified categories such as aided institution staff where adopted. Age: Government employees and eligible dependents. Income Limit: N/A; based on government employment status. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Hospitalization and day-care procedures under approved packages, Specified illness procedures (46 listed), Treatments under 2,992 approved procedures, Super-speciality and critical care at empanelled hospitals
        Exclusions: Outpatient (OPD) treatment, AYUSH treatments, Non-package and non-empanelled treatment outside rules, HIV/AIDS-related expenses as per guidelines
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

metadata.scheme_name: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme (Employees)

text:
Scheme: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme (Pensioners)
        Summary: Health insurance for Tamil Nadu government pensioners, family pensioners and eligible dependents, with basic sum insured of ₹7.50 lakh and up to ₹12 lakh for specified illnesses, effective July 2026 for a five-year block. Coverage: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; no Corpus Fund for pensioners.
        Coverage: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; no Corpus Fund for pensioners
        Eligibility: Target: State civil, teacher, All India Service and other eligible pensioners and family pensioners drawing pension from Tamil Nadu Consolidated Fund. Age: Pensioners and eligible dependents. Income Limit: N/A; based on pension status. BPL/SECC Required: No.
        Covered Conditions: Hospitalization and day-care procedures under approved packages, Specified illness procedures (46 listed), Treatments under 2,992 approved procedures, Super-speciality and critical care at empanelled hospitals
        Exclusions: Outpatient (OPD) treatment, AYUSH treatments, Non-package and non-empanelled treatment outside rules, HIV/AIDS-related expenses as per guidelines
        State: Tamil Nadu
        Government Level: State Government
        Department: Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
